title: Spicy Quinoa, Bean, and Pepper Salad
description: This spicy picnic salad recipe, featuring quinoa, peppers, black beans, and onions, can be served either hot or cold, making it a great picnic item.
ingredients: 0.5 teaspoon chipotle pepper powder, or more to taste
1 (15 ounce) can black beans, rinsed and drained

steps.text: Heat chile oil in a large saucepan over medium heat. Add onion and garlic; cook and stir until lightly browned, 5 to 7 minutes. Add bell pepper; cook and stir until slightly tender, 1 to 2 minutes.

Stir in quinoa, then pour in vegetable broth; season with chipotle pepper powder and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil, cover the saucepan, reduce heat to low, and simmer until quinoa is tender, about 20 minutes.
Stir black beans and corn into quinoa mixture until well combined. Simmer until beans and corn are heated through, about 5 minutes more.
